text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Phew... Today's training was extremely fruitful as well.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can feel mana overflowing throughout my entire body...
It seems I have taken another step closer to the otherworld.
choice_data_list: Let's keep going steadily at this pace.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's get plenty of rest to prepare for tomor—huh?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, Trainer!
I will pursue even more rigorous training from now on!
choice_data_list: W-what's gotten into you all of a sudden!?
W-what's wrong all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking up at the sky, ribbons of light beamed
through the breaks in the clouds. It was the mystical
natural phenomenon commonly known as "Jacob's Ladder."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A beacon of light leading towards the heavens.
There is no mistaking this for a divine revelation urging us to aim for even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
If I train even harder here,
it should bring me one step closer to that other world.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then let us run, let us train.
To gain the strength that can reach the skies!
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll be watching over you.
Got it. I'll be watching over you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Then let us run, let us train.
To gain the strength that can reach the skies!
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll be watching over you.
Got it. I'll be watching over you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Trainer.
Well then, I shall be off for some extra training!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: O heavens! Feast your eyes upon my running!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
B-But to let an opportunity like this
simply slip through our fingers...
choice_data_list: Look up at the sky once more.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Huh!? The light... it's gone out...
choice_data_list: Maybe it's telling me not to push myself too hard.
Maybe it's telling me not to push myself too hard, huh.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this was a trial.
To test whether I could maintain my composure and maneuver calmly in the face of an immediate opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"The trials of a Saint come in many forms.
Let us engrave that upon our hearts
and continue to walk forward."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Because the road to "that place"
still continues beyond this point.
